entry.title: New: Resolution 213 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN AGREEMENT WITH THE UNITED STATES DEPARTMENT OF COMMERCE NATIONAL OCEANIC AND ATMOSPHERIC ADMINISTRATION

Allows the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration to utilize the County of Hawai‘i’s Radio Repeater site at South Point to support its South Point Weather Radio Communication Network.
